overview_description.description: WorkFlowy is a tool for organizing your brain. It provides a powerful interface for hierarchical lists. People use it as a replacement for text editors and spreadsheets as organizational tools. They leave it open all day and put whatever passes through their brain in it - project plans, to-do's, meeting notes, brainstorms, etc..

about_short_description.short_description: WorkFlowy is a web-based app to organize activities such as daily work, team projects, research papers, journals and wedding planning.

product.name: Workflowy Digital Notebook
product.description: A web-based app that organizes notes, tasks, projects, and knowledge in a single, infinitely nested outline structure.

product.name: Kanban Boards
product.description: A feature that converts lists into nested kanban-style boards for visual task and project management.

product.name: Live Copies (Mirrors)
product.description: A feature that creates live, automatically updating copies of any item within Workflowy.

product.name: AI-Powered Features
product.description: Optional AI tools integrated with third-party language models to generate, edit, summarize, and improve content within Workflowy documents.

product.name: Sharing and Collaboration
product.description: Allows users to share any item or document with others, including those without Workflowy accounts, with configurable permissions.

product.name: Templates
product.description: A feature to create reusable document outlines by marking items as templates for quick duplication.
